reference_sql:
WITH like_for_like AS (
  -- one row per store open for the whole of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT store_code, country_code
  FROM stores
  WHERE opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND close_date IS NULL
), country_years AS (
  -- one row per country of the like-for-like stores
  SELECT l.country_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sa.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN sa.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sa.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' THEN sa.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_eur
  FROM sales sa
  JOIN like_for_like l ON l.store_code = sa.store_code
  WHERE sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY l.country_code
)
SELECT country_code, revenue_2024_eur, revenue_2025_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_2025_eur - revenue_2024_eur) / revenue_2024_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM country_years

solver.query:
SELECT st.country_code,
  SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31') AS revenue_2024_eur,
  SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS revenue_2025_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31')
    - SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'))
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM stores st
JOIN sales s ON s.store_code = st.store_code
WHERE st.opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01' AND st.close_date IS NULL
GROUP BY st.country_code
